units.source_text: 箱根对局前夜，名人把理发师唤到旅馆里来。

en.t: On the eve of the Hakone match, the Master summoned a barber to the inn.

units.source_text: 十七日，在伊东也让人剃了胡须。

en.t: On the seventeenth, in Ito as well, he had someone shave his beard.

units.source_text: 同在箱根时一样，夫人在背后支着他的头。

en.t: As she had done in Hakone, his wife supported his head from behind.
